children: Noble Corp plc (NE) filed a Form 8K - Director, Officer or Compensation Filing - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on November 04, 2026.

On October 29, 2026, Noble Corporation plc (the "Company") promoted Joey M. Kawaja from Senior Vice President of Operations, a position he has held since October 2022, to Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer of the Company, effective November 1, 2026.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1895262/000189526226000154/ne-20261029.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1895262/000189526226000154/0001895262-26-000154-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
